## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Sweden recorded 2,877K actual service units in 2025, in line with 2024 (2,874K).

- Actual 2025 service units were -5.6% below the plan (3,046K).

- Actual 2025 service units are -24.7% below the actual 2019 level (3,820K).
